# Playwright And Storybook

[Back to Workflow Reference](WORKFLOWS.md#playwright-and-storybook)

| Workflow                                                           | Type       | Runner                                                                      | Docker | Purpose                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| ------------------------------------------------------------------ | ---------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| [Playwright Tests](tests-playwright.yml)                           | Reusable   | `[self-hosted]` selector; `[self-hosted, Linux, Docker, Playwright]` shards | Yes    | Selects related specs, shards browser tests, and emits optional trusted Sentry/OTel artifacts.                                                                                                                                           |
| [Playwright Credentialed Tests](tests-playwright-credentialed.yml) | Reusable   | `[self-hosted, Linux, Docker, Playwright]`                                  | Yes    | Trusted credentialed browser specs.                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| [Storybook](storybook.yml)                                         | Reusable   | `[self-hosted, Playwright]`                                                 | No     | Trusted Storybook snapshots and browser/a11y validation, no Pages artifact and no write credentials; exact same-repository Dependabot/Renovate PRs receive only read-only snapshot and browser/a11y validation at the immutable PR head. |
| [Main CI (storybook)](main-storybook.yml)                          | Standalone | inherited via uses                                                          | No     | Validates Storybook; the centralized completed-run receiver dispatches successful source metadata to private infrastructure.                                                                                                             |
